title: ジャパンダートダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japan Dirt Derby. Smart Falcon is exuding confidence in her skill on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, unlike in the Satsuki Sho, where the runners were full of hope, today there's a tint of grim determination to many of the faces in the entrance tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some runners fall into dirt racing because they fail to find success on turf. Some feel cornered, as if they're at the end of the road.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This gives them a sense of standing on a cliff's edge. Smart Falcon accepts all of that collective pressure as she heads into the race.
